chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 228 - Ji Ning Returns Home, Claims Yinglong Guard Territory
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning returns to Brightheart Island after four years, reunites with Qiuye, reveals his Yinglong Guard status, and sets the stage for clan expansion and cold revenge.
og_title: The Prodigal Sword Immortal Returns - Desolate Era Ch. 228
og_description: Ji Ning is back in Yan Mountain with a Yinglong Guard token, two Wanxiang spirit-beasts, and a plan that makes the elders weep with joy.
twitter_title: Ji Ning's Homecoming Flex - Desolate Era Ch. 228
twitter_description: Our boy returns to Brightheart Island, drops a Yinglong Guard token, and the clan elders start planning an empire.

lore_anchors.definition: The Grand Xia Dynasty's elite immortal corps, requiring at least Wanxiang Adept level to join; members can claim a protected territory of ten thousand li, and the land remains under the Guard's protection for a thousand years even after the member's death.

The peak of the Wanxiang Adept realm, indicating that a cultivator has accumulated enough Yuan power to be on the verge of breaking through to the Primal Daoist stage; in Yan Mountain, a perfected Wanxiang is an almost mythical level of power.
A godbeast and Ji Ning's lifelong companion, now at Wanxiang late-stage; acts as a paternal figure and strategic anchor for the Ji Clan.

A godbeast of the Eastmarsh Swamp, capable of shrinking or enlarging its body at will, known for extreme speed and venom; Qingqing is a perfected Wanxiang great demon and Ji Ning's irreverent spirit-beast.
The first major realm of cultivation in the Mortal stage; a Houtian lifeform has not yet shed their mortal shell and is considered an ordinary warrior in the Xianxia hierarchy.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Ji Ning choose to live on Winged Serpent Lake instead of in the Black-White College?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He gains more value from the aquatic palace's Starseizing Hall than from the Black-White Diagram, and staying in Yan Mountain lets him protect his clan and prepare for his revenge against Snowdragon Mountain.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What does the Yinglong Guard token actually do?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Once refined by a Zifu Disciple and hung at the city lord's manor, it projects a spectral Yinglong over the city walls, signaling that the territory is under the protection of the Grand Xia's elite corps—any attack on it is an attack on the state.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Ji Ning not surprised that Qingshi is still at Houtian?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because Qingshi's aptitude is even lower than Qiuye's, and Ji Ning's own monstrous progress is the exception, not the rule; most cultivators in Yan Mountain take decades just to reach Xiantian, if they ever do.
